description: This file provides helper functions for handling forms and HTTP request data within the SuiteCRM project. It includes functions for validating required fields, populating beans from POST data, handling redirections, and managing relationships between entities, especially in the context of CRM forms.

classes.name: SubPanelTiles
classes.description: Represents a subpanel for linking related records within the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: checkRequired
methods.description: Checks if all required POST fields, with a given prefix, are set and non-empty.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates the properties of a given SugarBean object with data from the POST request, handling relationships and field types appropriately.

methods.name: add_hidden_elements
methods.description: Generates hidden HTML input elements for form data serialization.

methods.name: getPostToForm
methods.description: Creates hidden form fields from POST data, with optional regex-based ignoring.

methods.name: getGetToForm
methods.description: Creates hidden form fields from GET data, considering optional overrides.

methods.name: getAnyToForm
methods.description: Combines POST and GET data into hidden form fields for form submission.

methods.name: handleRedirect
methods.description: Performs a HTTP redirect based on request parameters or a constructed URL.

methods.name: buildRedirectURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL for redirection, handling various return actions and modules, including duplicate record creation cases.

methods.name: getLikeForEachWord
methods.description: Builds a SQL LIKE condition string for each word in a given string, with a minimum size constraint.

methods.name: isCloseAndCreateNewPressed
methods.description: Checks if the form submission indicates a 'Save and Create New' action.

methods.name: add_prospects_to_prospect_list
methods.description: Links prospect records to a parent prospect list based on relationship definitions.

methods.name: add_to_prospect_list
methods.description: Adds prospect objects to a prospect list via a specified relationship and query panel.

methods.name: save_from_report
methods.description: Links records from a report to a parent record using specified relationship attributes.
